description_en: Modifies the runtime parameters, optimization configurations, and user configurations of a specified application adapter
description_zh: 修改指定应用适配的运行参数、优化配置和用户配置
kebab_example: aliyun appstream-center update-adaptor --adaptor-id 'adt-bp1example****' --app-script '不适用（尚未启用）' --optimize-param '{}' --execute-file-address '不适用（尚未启用）' --silence-param --lang=zh-CN --user-config FixedResolution=1440x2560 DisconnectAction=KEEP_CURRENT ShowWindow=HIDE --api-version 2021-09-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateAdaptor

parameters.help_en: The ID of the application adapter to be modified. This parameter is required and must belong to an application adapter manageable by the current account
parameters.help_zh: 待修改的应用适配 ID。必须提供，并属于当前账号可管理的应用适配
parameters.name: adaptor_id

parameters.help_en:
Not enabled. Do not pass this parameter. This operation does not support modifying application scripts through this parameter.

The example "Not applicable (not enabled)" is only a description of the field status and is not a valid parameter value
parameters.help_zh:
尚未启用，请勿传入。 当前不支持通过本参数修改应用脚本。

示例“不适用（尚未启用）”仅为字段状态说明，不是可传入的参数值
parameters.name: app_script

parameters.help_en: The application optimization configuration, represented as a JSON object string. Pass this parameter only when specific optimization configuration requirements exist. The content must be a valid JSON object
parameters.help_zh: 应用优化配置，使用 JSON 对象的字符串表示。只在有明确优化配置要求时传入，内容必须是合法的 JSON 对象
parameters.name: optimize_param

parameters.help_en:
Not enabled. Do not pass this parameter. This operation does not support modifying executable file paths through this parameter.

The example "Not applicable (not enabled)" is only a description of the field status and is not a valid parameter value
parameters.help_zh:
尚未启用，请勿传入。 当前不支持通过本参数修改可执行文件路径。

示例“不适用（尚未启用）”仅为字段状态说明，不是可传入的参数值
parameters.name: execute_file_address

parameters.help_en: The command-line parameters used when the application starts. If not empty, this parameter is used to update the startup parameters of the application adapter. Specify the value based on the startup requirements of the application
parameters.help_zh: 应用启动时使用的命令行参数。非空时用于更新该应用适配的启动参数，请按应用本身的启动要求填写
parameters.name: silence_param

fields.help_en: The processing policy after a connection is disconnected. When modifying other UserConfig configurations, if you need to retain the original policy, pass the original value in the complete configuration object. This operation does not automatically populate default values
fields.help_zh: 连接断开后的处理策略。修改其他 UserConfig 配置时，如需保留原策略，请在完整配置对象中同时传入原值；本接口不会自动补充默认值
fields.name: disconnect_action

fields.help_en: The fixed resolution used when the application runs, in the format of width × height, in pixels
fields.help_zh: 应用运行时使用的固定分辨率，格式为宽度x高度，单位为像素
fields.name: fixed_resolution

fields.help_en: The application window display configuration. When modifying other UserConfig configurations, if you need to retain the original configuration, pass the original value in the complete configuration object. This operation does not automatically populate default values
fields.help_zh: 应用窗口显示配置。修改其他 UserConfig 配置时，如需保留原配置，请在完整配置对象中同时传入原值；本接口不会自动补充默认值
fields.name: show_window

parameters.help_en:
The application runtime configuration object. If this parameter is omitted, the existing user configuration is not modified.

If passed, the original UserConfig is entirely replaced and not merged item by item. Submit the complete configuration and include the configuration items that need to be retained. Subfields that are not provided do not automatically inherit the original values
parameters.help_zh:
应用运行配置对象。省略整个参数时不修改现有用户配置。

传入后会整体替换原 UserConfig，不会逐项合并。请提交完整配置，并同时带上仍需保留的配置项；未提供的子字段不会自动沿用原值
parameters.name: user_config

schema.description_en: The response result of this API call
schema.description_zh: 本次 API 调用的响应结果

Code.description_en: The error code. This parameter is returned when the request fails. A successful response may not contain this field
Code.description_zh: 错误码。请求失败时返回；成功响应可能不包含该字段

Data.description_en: Indicates whether the operation was processed successfully. A value of true indicates that the operation was successful
Data.description_zh: 本次操作是否处理成功。true 表示操作成功

Message.description_en: The error or result message. This parameter describes the cause when the request fails. A successful response may not contain this field
Message.description_zh: 错误或结果提示。请求失败时用于说明原因，成功响应可能不包含该字段

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier of the request. You can provide this value when troubleshooting issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次请求的唯一标识，排查问题时可提供该值

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was processed successfully. A value of true indicates that the request was processed successfully. To check whether an asynchronous task is completed, query the task status separately
Success.description_zh: 请求是否处理成功。true 表示本次请求处理成功；异步任务是否完成须另外查询任务状态
